rules.statement: The Principal Collector of Customs had neither actual authority under sections 17 and 108 of the Customs Ordinance nor ostensible authority on behalf of the Crown to sell goods belonging to the Crown for non-payment of warehouse rent.
rules.supporting_quote: "Their Lordships think therefore that nothing done by the Principal Collector or the Chief Secretary amounted to a holding out by the Crown that the Principal Collector had the right to enter into a contract to sell the goods which are the subject-matter of this action."
